workarounds.symptom: [v2] docs:api fails on native Windows with backslash entry-point globs
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(docs): use relative POSIX package entry globs. Target files: typedoc.config.mjs. On native Windows, `docs:api` receives absolute package entry points containing backslashes. TypeDoc treats these as glob escapes, finds none of the eight public packages, and exits with an error. Use package-relative POSIX globs so TypeDoc can resolve them and escape special characters in the checkout directory. Filesystem reads keep their native paths. (Ref: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/typescript-sdk/pull/3016)

workarounds.symptom: [v2] Incompatibility with refresh_tokens from Azure when client_id=resource_id
workarounds.workaround: Fix: feat(client): add an opt-in for sending scope on token refresh. Target files: examples/guides/clients/oauth.examples.ts, packages/client/src/client/auth.ts, packages/client/test/client/auth.test.ts. Some authorization servers reject a refresh-token request that carries no `scope` (#2718: Microsoft Entra ID answers AADSTS90009 when the client and the resource are the same app registration).
